cloakroom: Available near the temple complex for safe deposit of pilgrim luggage and belongings.
drinking_water: Water Plant and purified drinking water supply points installed across the hill and temple complex.
toilets: Public amenities centers and sanitation blocks available both uphill and downhill near choultries.
footwear_counter: Designated footwear custody counters provided before entering the main temple premises.
annadanam: Free feeding / Annadanam schemes organized by Devasthanam. Special Pulihora & Dadhojanam schemes and Nitya Annadanam trust operate daily.
wheelchair_accessibility: Wheelchair-accessible parking zones and pathways close to main darshan entry barricades, along with elevator access directly to the upper sanctum floor.
parking: Main hilltop Annavaram Temple car parking area with dedicated spaces for cars, cabs, two-wheelers, auto-rickshaws, and wheelchair-accessible zones. Also parking place at Hari Hara Sadan.
other_facilities: Devasthanam Ghat Road bus shuttles running frequently for every train connecting Railway Station and Hilltop
Devasthanam long-distance buses: Annavaram to Simhachalam (Daily 7:30 AM uphill) and Annavaram to Kotipalli (Daily 6:00 AM & 12:00 PM uphill)
Air-Conditioned Vratham Halls accommodating up to 1,500 vrathams at a time
West Gopuram Direct Sanctum Lift / Elevator
